description: Clear an active timed or manual hold on a connected account and wake any queued posts that were waiting. Overdue waiting posts send right away; future posts keep their original times. Refused with 409 (reconnect_required) if the account needs a fresh sign-in first.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: A held connected account id from accounts_list.

name: accounts_resume
title: Resume a held account
